entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What a lovely restaurant.
You like it here?
This is my first time here.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I do.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I've never had the joy of dining in[n]such a place with... someone I love.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That must explain my nerves[n]at the moment...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, really?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's new for me as well...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: To be at a place like this... Accompanied[n]by the one I care about.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: My goodness. Maybe that's why I'm[n]suddenly so nervous...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank you so much for today.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Somehow, you seemed even more[n]debonair than usual when we were[n]walking to our table...
You're making me blush.
Thanks.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Indeed.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, excuse me for a moment.
When should I give her the gift?
○○○ is calling me...
I can't answer this now...!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Who's calling you now?
It's not a big deal.
Don't worry about it.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Right.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Sorry to keep you waiting.

entries.speaker: Announcer
entries.en: Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for[n]joining us on this special day.

entries.speaker: Announcer
entries.en: We wish you all an unforgettable[n]evening, with one last finishing touch[n]from us...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hm? What could this be?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...It's beautiful...
This is for you.
I want you to have this.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What...?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: O-Oh... Thank you...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I, ah... I don't know what to say.[n]I certainly didn't expect flowers...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...I promise I'll take good care of them.
Thanks.
I really do appreciate you.
Surprise.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm the one who should be thanking[n]you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yes... I can certainly feel that.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm thankful to have you, too.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: And what a surprise it is.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I take it you put quite a bit of[n]preparation into this.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Then again, perhaps I should have[n]expected this...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You always go to such lengths to make[n]other people happy.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I can only aspire to do that, myself.
I'm sure you can do it.
I'm looking forward to it.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's quite a feeling. To love and admire[n]someone all at once...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I hope we can spend even more time[n]together like this.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: In fact... once we're done here, would[n]you like to take a walk in the city?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I... I don't want this night to end just yet.
Haru and I spent some[n]time alone together...
entries.uk: Ми з Хару провели[n]трохи часу наодинці...

entries.en: Once it got late, I walked her[n]back to the station...
